report_topic: Systems and Controls in assessment and collection of mineral receipts
observations_summary: The audit revealed significant deficiencies in Bihar's mineral receipt assessment and collection, including incomplete District Survey Reports, illegal mining in prohibited areas, and substantial revenue losses (hundreds of crores) due to uncollected royalties, interest, security deposits, and stamp duties. Key issues also included the non-utilisation of ₹82.30 crore in the District Mineral Foundation Fund, widespread illegal mining, and functional issues in the e-challan system leading to the use of unrealistic/unfit vehicles and fake e-challans.
